ML Platform Engineer
Arbor AI, Zurich

About the role
Arbor AI ships forecasting products for agriculture. You will industrialize how models reach production.

Requirements
At least 5 years of engineering experience with 2 years in ML systems.
Model development experience with PyTorch.
Serving and orchestrating training workloads on Kubernetes.
Experiment tracking and a model registry with MLflow.

Nice to have
Cloud experience on AWS.

Responsibilities
Build the training and serving platform.
Cut model deployment time from days to hours.
Partner with researchers on reproducibility.
